name: Passionfruit & Ginger Cocktail
steps: Make ginger passion fruit syrup with sugar, water, ginger, passion fruit, lemon juice and zest. Serve with light rum, soda water, fresh mint, and lemon slices.

name: Rosemary Gin Cocktail
steps: Make rosemary syrup, then stir gin, lemon juice, and rosemary syrup over ice. Top with club soda and garnish with rosemary.

name: Gin & Ginger Cocktail
steps: Divide ingredients between four highball glasses filled with ice and mix well. Garnish with lime and candied ginger.

name: Provencale
steps: Stir gin, vermouth, and Cointreau with ice. Strain into a chilled martini glass and garnish with orange twist.

name: Vesper
steps: Shake well until ice cold, strain into a deep champagne goblet, and add a thin slice of lemon peel.

name: Paddington Cocktail
steps: Rinse a chilled coupe with absinthe. Shake remaining ingredients with ice and strain into the prepared glass.

name: Bombay Government Punch
steps: Make sugar syrup, combine with lime juice, arrack, rum, and water. Chill, add a large ice block, and grate nutmeg over the top.

name: The Corsican Cocktail
steps: Combine chilled Lillet, limoncello, elderflower syrup, and lemon juice. Top with club soda and garnish with lemon twists.

name: C & B Old Fashioned
steps: Stir ingredients with ice, strain into a rocks glass, and serve with a large cube and orange peel.

name: Paella
steps: Toast rice in oil, add broth and simmer. Top with seafood and vegetables, cook until seafood is done and rice is tender.

name: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Saute mushrooms until golden, set aside. Make risotto, then fold in mushrooms at the end.

name: Risotto Milanese
steps: Toast rice, add wine, then broth one ladle at a time while stirring constantly. Finish with butter and cheese.

name: Osso Buco
steps: Brown shanks, saute vegetables, deglaze with wine, and braise for 2 or more hours until tender. Finish with gremolata.

name: Beef Ragu
steps: Brown beef, saute aromatics, add tomatoes and wine, then braise low and slow for 2 to 3 hours until tender.

name: Eggplant Parmesan
steps: Bread and fry eggplant slices, layer with sauce and cheese, then bake until golden and bubbly.

name: Lasagna Bolognese
steps: Layer noodles with sauces and cheese, then bake at 350F for 45 minutes until bubbly.

name: Marinara Sauce
steps: Saute garlic in olive oil, add tomatoes, simmer 20 to 30 minutes, season to taste, and finish with basil.

name: Pasta Primavera
steps: Saute or blanch vegetables, toss with cooked pasta, olive oil and herbs, then add lemon zest and juice.

name: Puttanesca
steps: Saute garlic and anchovies until dissolved. Add tomatoes, olives and capers, then toss with pasta.

name: Bolognese Sauce
steps: Saute vegetables and meat, add tomato paste and wine, simmer slowly for 2 to 3 hours, and finish with milk.

name: Carbonara
steps: Crisp guanciale, then toss with hot pasta. Off heat, mix in egg mixture and pasta water to create sauce.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
steps: Toast garlic in olive oil with red pepper flakes. Toss with hot pasta and pasta water, then finish with parsley.

name: Black Bean and Sweet Potato Tacos
steps: Roast cubed sweet potato, warm beans with spices, and serve in tortillas with toppings.

name: Thai Red Curry with Chicken
steps: Saute curry paste, add coconut milk and simmer. Add chicken and vegetables, cook through, then finish with lime and basil.

name: Spinach and Ricotta Stuffed Shells
steps: Mix filling, stuff cooked shells, arrange with sauce, and bake until bubbly.

name: Roasted Chicken with Root Vegetables
steps: Season chicken and vegetables with herbs and oil. Roast at 425F until the chicken is cooked.

name: Beef Stir-Fry with Broccoli
steps: Cook beef in batches, stir-fry broccoli, add sauce and beef back in, and serve over rice.

name: Shrimp Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
steps: Saute seasoned shrimp. Make cabbage slaw with lime and cilantro. Serve in warm tortillas with crema.

name: Sheet Pan Salmon and Vegetables
steps: Roast seasoned vegetables at 400F, add salmon, and roast until cooked through.

name: Lemon Chicken Piccata
steps: Pound chicken thin and saute until golden. Make sauce with lemon juice, capers and broth.

name: Creamy Garlic Butter Mushroom Pasta
steps: Saute mushrooms in butter with garlic, add cream, simmer, then toss with pasta and thyme.

name: Baked Feta Pasta
steps: Roast tomatoes and feta, then toss with hot pasta and basil.
